test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Hemis Festival is widely celebrated in which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ladakh**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Hemis Festival is widely celebrated in the union territory of Ladakh, which was earlier a part of the northern Indian state of Jammu and Kashmir until 2019 when it was reorganized.
 
• The Hemis Festival is a significant event and a huge draw for tourists at the Hemis Monastery, the largest Buddhist monastery in Ladakh.
